# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Repository overview

- `rentless` is currently a minimal repository.
- The root `README.md` is the only project documentation.
- No build, lint, test, or dependency-management configuration is currently present.

## Contribution guidance

- Inspect the existing files before proposing or making changes.
- Keep changes focused on the requested task and avoid adding dependencies unless they are necessary.
- Preserve the existing repository structure and naming conventions.
- Update `README.md` when introducing user-facing behavior or setup instructions.
- Do not claim that tests, builds, or linters passed when no corresponding tooling exists.
- Before committing, review the complete diff and check that no credentials or other secrets were added.
